pages.note: M41 names no dedicated payment-editor frame. The actual Inbox source uses supplied M25 104:950; its checked payment and financial/undo controls reuse the supplied M29 and Desktop18 utility-sheet spacing, monochrome tokens and 44px controls. This report compares those shared design contexts and leaves content/layout differences visible and informational. All data is created through actual local forms. No provider, Auth, backend, workflow or publication is used.
